## Summary

Describe the user problem and the resulting behavior.

## Contract impact

List changes to configuration, state, theme, output, or workflows. Write `None`
when there is no public contract change.

## Verification

- [ ] `bun run quality`
- [ ] `bun run typecheck`
- [ ] `bun test`
- [ ] `bun run acceptance`
- [ ] No secrets, private content, or unrelated generated files are included

## Risks

Describe compatibility, security, and operational risks, plus any intentionally
deferred work.
